title: abutilon jacquinii
intro: Abutilon jacquinii, commonly known as the orange flowered melochia or melochia, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and supporting respiratory health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms such as pain, cough, and cold. The bioactive constituents of Abutilon jacquinii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
